issues: 浅灰底 + 通用小字卡片，四张卡只有 340×220、文字读不清，画面大面积空
标题竖直平砸下来，落在"空气"上，没有着力面，冲击从哪里传到卡片说不清
四张卡等高弹起、末卡歪向左但侧边栏从左往右进，动量方向的出处很弱
前 36f 静置读布景，超过 1 秒画面几乎不动
changes: look 改为自定义「混凝土 · 信号橙」瑞士网格：暖灰混凝土底、128px 粗黑体标题（橙色逗号）、四块 335×330 黑色多米诺 KPI 石板（76px 数字 + 橙色增幅胶囊 + 走势线），虚构运营看板 Cairn
撞击一有着力面：标题带 3.5° 歪斜自由落体、右端先着地、2f 拍平落在发丝规线上，规线像蹦床下弯回弹、标题压扁回弹、两端扬尘，全画面竖震 10px
冲击方向可见：一道橙色地面脉冲从右往左跑，依次顶起石板 4→1，弹高逐级放大 50→76px（多米诺能量放大链），空中向左微倾、落地 squash、接触影随高度变化
撞击二：最左一块带 -3° 左倾落地、震 6px，黑色侧边栏从左墙弹入（snappy + 14px 过冲回正 + 横向运动模糊），导航项比面板晚 2–3f 错峰跟随
节奏重排为 150f：布景缩到 22f 并用"标题落影在规线上逐渐变深"预告下落，三级链 39→68f，落定后 60f hold + 1.0→1.015 极缓推镜
issuesEn: Light grey background with generic small-text cards; the four cards were only 340×220 with unreadable text, and most of the frame was empty
The title dropped straight down and landed on nothing, so it was unclear how the impact reached the cards
All four cards bounced to the same height, and the last card tilted left while the sidebar slid in from the left, so the momentum had a weak source
The first 36f were a static read of the set, more than a second with almost nothing moving
changesEn: Custom 'concrete and signal orange' Swiss-grid look: warm grey concrete, a 128px heavy black headline with an orange comma, and four 335×330 black domino-like KPI slabs (76px figures, orange delta pills, trend lines) for a fictional ops board, Cairn

Impact one has a surface: the headline falls tilted 3.5°, its right end lands first and it slaps flat in 2f onto a hairline rule that bows and rebounds like a trampoline, with title squash, dust at both ends and a 10px vertical frame shake

The impact direction is visible: an orange floor pulse runs right to left and kicks slabs 4 to 1 in turn, with hop heights amplifying 50 to 76px (dominoes amplify energy), a slight left lean in the air, landing squash and height-aware contact shadows

Impact two: the leftmost slab lands leaning -3° with a 6px shake and the black sidebar springs in from the left wall (snappy, 14px overshoot and settle, horizontal motion blur), its nav items following 2-3f behind the panel
Retimed to 150f: the set is cut to 22f and the title's shadow darkening on the rule foreshadows the drop, the three-level chain runs 39 to 68f, then a 60f hold with a 1.0 to 1.015 slow push
